programme.desc: Las Vegas, known as America's playground, attracts crowds of tourists eager for entertainment and nightlife.This city full of neon lights, casinos and concerts is also a place where many people find employment.Marcin Prokop goes to Nevada to look at the lives of employees behind the scenes.He meets Nicole, whose dream is to become an erotic dancer in one of the clubs.After her stay in Barcelona, ​​she returns to Las Vegas to start her career.The host also talks to Internet creator Steve, who describes everyday life in the city and the threats that may await people here.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: More than 170,000 members of this tribe live on the Navajo Nation reservation.The picturesque areas located in four states were supposed to be an enclave of free Indians.In fact, they often resemble vast ghettos.The history of the Navajo is rich and painful, as Marcin Prokop discovers during a visit to one of the last living cryptographers from this tribe, who fought in the Pacific during World War II.The next hero is Loren Anthony, who grew up in the mountains, living in primitive conditions.As a teenager, he formed a metal band, which allowed him to express generational frustrations.After various life challenges, Loren decided to focus on music, charity work and supporting his community.For many young residents of the reserve, this type of creativity is a way to shout out wrongs and escape from the sad reality.Navajos fight stereotypes, valuing the value of their community and traditions, which encourages them to remain in the difficult areas of the reservation.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: After several years of efforts, Martyna receives permission to come to China.He visits the Shaolin Valley area, where the influence of the traditional, strict upbringing of the Chinese is most clearly visible.Currently, over 5,000 students study at the school, which originates from a legendary Buddhist monastery.He teaches them, among others:Liu Yin Ping, a fifth-degree kung fu master.She is the only woman who lives on the school premises with her husband, the vice-champion of martial arts in all of China.The woman has a five-year-old son, but she also has to be a mother to her children, the youngest of whom are five years old.Students start their day at 5:40 a.m., and at 6:00 a.m. they have their first martial arts training.They spend all their time at school and visit their parents only once a year.They believe they can achieve any goal, they just have to work hard enough.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Every year, surrogate mothers in India give birth to approximately 25,000 babies.Nearly half of this number are 'orders' from Western couples.In Annand, Martyna meets Dr. Nyana Patel, who runs a fertility clinic and a surrogacy home.About eighty pregnant women are under her care.They are usually young and often illiterate girls from small towns, who thus earn the equivalent of ten years' income in just 9 months.The demand for their services is huge.The Polish traveler learns the stories of women who decided to rent their bodies to give birth to children to other people.He meets Manisia, who has three children of her own, and a married couple who, thanks to Dr. Patel and one of the surrogates, have the desired offspring.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: In Thailand, any teenager can legally buy and use hormones that will enable him to change his gender if he feels the need.Operations changing men into women and vice versa are also carried out on a massive scale in the country.Martyna meets a doctor who runs the oldest clinic in Bangkok offering this type of services, and assists him during the procedure.The traveler also meets his patients and looks behind the scenes of the selection of the most beautiful ladyboys in Thailand.He also meets a talented dancer, Lukpad, whom he accompanies in his everyday life and during preparations for the show in which she appears.
